description: node:test conformance tests that check an implementation's exported types at compile time and its serialization at run time.

supports.description: Compile-time equality of the exported type's keys, optionality and readonly members with the declared type.
Round-trip of contract-conforming payloads through the module's parse and serialize functions, and rejection of payloads missing a required member.

unsupported.reason: Routines are qualified by the SQL and PowerShell profiles.

tooling.purpose: Compiles the generated tests against the implementation's declarations.
Runs the generated tests with the node:test runner.

proofLimits: The tests check exported shape and serialization only; business behavior is never generated or asserted.
Type equality is checked by the compiler; values outside the generated samples are not exercised.

checks.claim: The generated tests compile against the implementation module's declarations.
The generated node:test tests pass against the conforming implementation fixture and fail against the violating fixture.
checks.limits: Exported shape and serialization subset only.
